    (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) :
    InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd
      (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) / ‖x - ζ‖ ^ n)
      ({ζ}ᶜ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))

source.title: Axler-Bourdon-Ramey Harmonic Function Theory, second edition

binder_audit.n: TYPING: natural dimension of the real Euclidean carrier
binder_audit.hζ: SOURCE: ζ belongs to the unit sphere, expressed ‖ζ‖=1

definition_audit.kernel: literal quotient (1-‖x‖²)/‖x-ζ‖^n on the pole-free domain; totalized division at the excluded pole is not a source claim
definition_audit.harmonicity: Mathlib InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd: local C2 and zero Laplacian on a neighborhood at every domain point; the target domain is open
definition_audit.domain: literal complement of the singleton pole; no restriction to the open unit ball and no pole-free regularity supplied as a premise
